shows: An iPad action sheet shown as a popover near the top-right toolbar button, with title, message and three stacked pill actions.
visual_question: How does an action sheet present on iPad and how are destructive and ordinary actions ordered?
facts: Anchored popover card at the right edge under the trailing toolbar button, no dimmed scrim visible, no Cancel row; title (short), 1-sentence message, full-width pill buttons stacked with Destructive in red first then Action 2 and Action 3 in black on gray; Light.

shows: An iPad share sheet as a popover under the trailing toolbar button with grabber, header, people row, app row, action circles and a list.
visual_question: What are the layers of the iPad activity view and where is it anchored?
facts: Popover with caret at the trailing toolbar button, grabber on top, circular close at top-right; header with thumbnail, Title, Subtitle, Collaborate pill and permission caption; then a people row (avatar with app badge, name, 2 People caption), an app row (AirDrop, Messages, Mail, Notes), a circular quick-action row (Copy, Add to Favorites, Add to Reading), then a gray grouped action list with icon plus label that scrolls off the bottom; row 3 labels truncate with ellipsis; Light.

shows: Two iPad portrait-height frames of a centered alert with title, message, a text-field group and Cancel and Default buttons, one with the keyboard open and one without.
visual_question: How does an iPad alert with a text field lay out buttons and move when the keyboard opens?
facts: Narrow centered card; title, message sentence, grouped Value fields (label row and placeholder row) inside a gray inset; two side-by-side pills, Cancel gray left and Default blue filled right; with keyboard the alert pins to the top of the screen above the keyboard with suggestion bar, without it the alert sits vertically centered; background dims gray; Light.

shows: An iPad color picker popover with eyedropper, Colors title, close, Grid/Spectrum/Sliders segmented control, color grid, opacity slider and swatch row.
visual_question: What anatomy does the system color picker show on iPad?
facts: Popover with caret pointing at a color well (rainbow ring with selected color) at bottom center; header eyedropper left, Colors title center, X right; 3-segment control Grid selected; 12-column grayscale row above a hue grid with selected cell outlined white; OPACITY caption with checkerboard gradient slider and 100 percent value; large current-color square plus two rows of saved swatches ending in a plus button, one swatch ringed as selected; Light.

shows: An iPad context menu beside a lifted Content Area card, with a top icon row, plain, disabled and destructive actions, and a submenu row.
visual_question: What is in a context menu and how are disabled, destructive and submenu items distinguished?
facts: Rounded translucent card next to the raised preview on a dimmed gray background; top row of 3 icon-over-label quick actions (first highlighted, last red truncated), divider, rows with leading icon: Label, Disabled Action in light gray, Destructive Action in red, divider, Submenu with trailing chevron; no trailing icons; Light.

shows: An iPad Lock Screen with Control Center controls (connectivity, media, sliders, toggles, tiles) on the right and lock widgets on the left.
visual_question: What controls and sizes does iPad Control Center contain and where does it sit?
facts: Glass tiles stacked in the right third: 2x2 connectivity cluster (airplane, hotspot, Wi-Fi blue-on, cellular, Bluetooth), media tile with Track and Artist and transport, camera and silent buttons, two vertical sliders (brightness, volume), focus tile and a large Title/Detail tile, rotation lock, screen mirroring, battery; on-state in blue fill, off-state gray glass; right edge page dots for favorites, music, connectivity; wallpaper visible through; Dark-ish wallpaper style.

shows: iPad Home Screen in dim mode with a Home Screen quick actions menu over the bottom-right app icon, with a widget-size row below the actions.
visual_question: What does the Home Screen quick actions menu contain on iPad?
facts: Glass menu anchored under the pressed icon, list with icon plus label: Remove App in red, Require Face ID, Edit Home Screen, then custom Actions; bottom strip of five widget size icons (first selected) for widgets; rest of grid dimmed, dock stays; the menu overlaps the dock; Light wallpaper dimmed.

shows: Four iPad Home Screen frames showing a purple placeholder widget at small, medium, large and extra-large sizes with icons reflowing around it.
visual_question: How do iPad widget sizes occupy the Home Screen grid?
facts: Placeholder in top-left; small = 1 icon-cell square (about 2x2 icon slots grid), medium = 2 cells wide by 1 tall, large = 2 by 2, extra large = 4 wide by 2 tall as measured in icon slots; icons reflow to the right and below and a Your App icon ends the grid; status bar App label at right; the extra-large widget spans about half the grid width; Light wallpaper.

shows: An iPad Home Screen with a 6-column icon grid, page dots and a translucent dock with a folder at its trailing end.
facts: App icons sit in rows of six with name captions under each, page dots above the dock, dock rounded translucent with 7 apps then a divider and a folder or recents cluster; Your App placeholder icon is last; status bar shows time, date, App at left and nothing right.
reason: Same Home Screen is shown with widgets in K062 and with quick actions in K061, so this is the weaker runtime asset.

shows: Two iPad frames with a Title and Subtitle, a trailing Search field and the full-width iPad keyboard, one in uppercase and one in lowercase suggestions.
visual_question: What does the iPad keyboard layout show and how do suggestions and keys differ between shifted and unshifted states?
facts: Keyboard fills the lower width; top suggestion bar with undo, redo, paste at left and 3 predictions; QWERTY with number hints above top row, tab, delete, return, two shift keys, emoji, .?123 twice, microphone, and keyboard-dismiss key; shifted state shows keys unchanged and suggestions uppercase; navigation bar has Search field with microphone at the trailing side; Light.

shows: An iPad inset-grouped list with a header and Action, then rows with chevron, subtitle, thumbnail, button, date pills, pop-up, stepper and switch.
visual_question: What trailing control kinds can an iPad list row hold?
facts: Centered readable-width card on a gray background (not full width) with large title at the leading edge and 3 toolbar buttons grouped at the trailing edge; header text with blue Action; rows: Detail plus star plus chevron, Title with Subtitle, thumbnail row, blue text Button, blue chevron, date pill, date and time pills, time pill with reorder handle, Pop-up with up-down glyph, stepper, green switch, centered blue Action row; Light.

shows: An iPad Lock Screen with date, time, left-side widgets for calendar, weather, stock and clock, and no controls.
facts: Large centered clock, a lock glyph above it, date and weather line, left column of widgets (date, event, rings, stock sparkline, analog clock, city time); home indicator at bottom; Light-on-dark wallpaper.
reason: Same layout appears with Control Center in K060 and with notifications in K068.

shows: Two iPad frames of an edit menu over selected text, a compact bar and an expanded menu with a submenu.
visual_question: How does the text edit menu show as a compact bar versus a full menu with submenus?
facts: Selected text with blue grab handles; compact capsule with 3 Item labels and a chevron to expand; expanded card with Cut Copy Paste icon row, then separator groups of Label rows, red first label, chevron rows opening a second card to the right; title and back button with trailing Search field in the navigation bar; Light.

shows: Two iPad Lock Screen frames, one with stacked notification rows and one with an expanded notification plus actions.
visual_question: How do notifications stack and expand on iPad Lock Screen?
facts: Centered column; 4 rows each with app icon, Title, Message and 9:41 AM, third and fourth show stacked layers beneath; expanded card with header row (icon, Title, Description, time), custom content area in blue, and a separate glass action list below with icon plus Action rows; widgets stay left, clock dims; Dark-ish wallpaper.

shows: An iPad popover with caret above an Open Popover button, plain white content.
facts: Popover card with rounded corners and a caret pointing at its blue Open Popover pill; no scrim, soft shadow; background is gray grouped, title and three trailing toolbar buttons behind.
reason: K058 and K056 show real content inside popovers, so this blank one adds only the caret and shadow.

shows: An iPad sheet narrower than the screen with grabber, close at left, title, blue send button at right, floating above the keyboard.
visual_question: How does an iPad sheet that takes text look next to the keyboard?
facts: Floating card inset from both sides, top corners and bottom corners rounded, grabber on top, circular X dismiss at the leading edge, centered Title, filled blue circle with up arrow for commit at the trailing edge; background dims gray; keyboard shown below, sheet does not cover it; Light.

shows: An iPad split layout with a sidebar of search, list rows and collapsible sections, and a content pane with a top tab bar.
visual_question: How does the iPad sidebar sit next to content and mark the selected row?
facts: Sidebar at the left about a quarter wide, translucent; top has Edit and two icon buttons, then Search with microphone, rows with blue leading icon, Title and gray Detail; selected row filled with a rounded gray capsule; Section Heading rows with a trailing chevron down; content pane white with back button, floating tab bar with sidebar toggle, 5 tabs and search glyph, Title and Subtitle; resize grip at bottom-right; Light.

shows: Two iPad frames of a floating top tab bar, one plain and one with a Search Term field beneath it.
visual_question: How does the iPad tab bar sit at the top and how does search appear with it?
facts: Centered capsule with sidebar toggle, Tab 1 to Tab 5 and search glyph, Tab 1 selected with blue label on gray pill; two round toolbar buttons at the trailing edge; search state keeps the bar and adds a field with magnifier, Search Term and microphone, same width as the bar, directly below it; Light.

shows: Four iPad frames showing top toolbar layouts: title with search, bottom toolbar, centered title, compact large title and large title.
visual_question: Which toolbar and title layouts does iPad offer?
facts: Frame 1 inline Title and Subtitle at left with trailing button and Search field, plus three bottom clusters at left, center and right; frame 2 two buttons leading, centered Title and Subtitle, trailing button and Search; frame 3 Compact Large Title at left with trailing button and Search on the same line; frame 4 two buttons each side with Large Title and Subtitle below; all buttons are round glass; Light.

shows: Two overlapping iPad windows on a wallpaper, each a sidebar plus content, front window with red yellow green window controls.
visual_question: How does an iPad app window look in windowed mode?
facts: Back window dimmed and clipped by the front one; front window has traffic-light dots at top-left, Edit button, sidebar rows with Detail, content pane with back button and Title and Subtitle; resize grip curve at bottom-right corner; back window shows ellipsis menu in place of the dots; wallpaper visible around; Light.
